outcome: Symptoms of acute pancreatitis in pregnancy (APIP)
cohort: 121 pregnant women diagnosed with acute pancreatitis in pregnancy (APIP)
finding: The severity of acute pancreatitis in pregnancy was significantly correlated with higher risks for maternal and fetal death.
mod_finding: The study found that 72.7% of moderate-to-severe acute pancreatitis in pregnancy (APIP) patients underwent Cesarean section to terminate gestation safely.
